name: Upstash Box Free
free_limit: Up to 10 concurrent hosted agent sandboxes; 5 CPU core-hours per month, with 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM and up to 10 GB disk per free box. Supports Node.js, Python, Go, Ruby and Rust.
watch_out: Free boxes pause after 1 hour idle; processes stop until resumed, so this is not an always-on VPS. Keep-alive requires a paid plan. AI agents require your own model-provider key and may incur separate model charges. Region is AWS us-east-1; commercial-use terms for the Free plan are not explicitly confirmed.
